findings.title: Non-loopback HTTP endpoint configured
findings.explanation: A non-loopback URL explicitly uses HTTP. This indicates an unencrypted endpoint in source or configuration, but does not prove the endpoint is reachable or used.
findings.potential_impact: If the endpoint carries sensitive data over an untrusted network, traffic may be observed or modified in transit.
findings.remediation: Use HTTPS with certificate verification for the service and confirm that the device rejects invalid certificates.
